description:
Cast Mondrak by paying its mana cost.
When Mondrak enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Mondrak with haste plus at least one additional token due to Mondrak's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of A Realm Reborn to tap one of the Mondrak tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Mondrak.
Holding priority, use the ability of A Realm Reborn to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.
